TEST FIXTURE - small vendor table in IEEE oui.txt format, used only by tests/test_r3.py.
The first ten entries are copied verbatim from the IEEE MA-L registry (/usr/share/ieee-data/oui.txt, 2022-08 build).
The last two are TEST-ONLY prefixes with the locally-administered bit (0x02) set. Real IEEE MA-L entries never have
that bit set, so a tool that leans on "the table won't match an LAA address" instead of checking the bit would pass
a test without them. They simulate a CID entry or a bad table.

A4-83-E7   (hex)		Apple, Inc.
00-00-0C   (hex)		Cisco Systems, Inc
00-02-5B   (hex)		Cambridge Silicon Radio
F8-04-2E   (hex)		SAMSUNG ELECTRO-MECHANICS(THAILAND)
5C-F9-38   (hex)		Apple, Inc.
28-CF-E9   (hex)		Apple, Inc.
98-01-A7   (hex)		Apple, Inc.
AC-BC-32   (hex)		Apple, Inc.
D0-03-4B   (hex)		Apple, Inc.
3C-5A-B4   (hex)		Google, Inc.
DA-A1-19   (hex)		TEST-ONLY LAA PREFIX A
1A-2B-3C   (hex)		TEST-ONLY LAA PREFIX B
